_comment: Shared ability pool. Weapons and backgrounds both reference these by id, so adding either costs no combat code — combat.js dispatches on the id. Abilities with track 'weapon' are the active things you press in a fight; abilities with track 'background' are passives and world effects, and each declares a `hook` that the engine consults in exactly one place. Keeping the two tracks split is what lets 9 weapons x 10 backgrounds be 90 distinct kits without the combat surface doubling.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.text: Once per encounter, when an enemy misses you, make an immediate attack against it.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.text: Bonus action. Heal 1d10 + your level. Once per rest.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.text: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, immediately attack another enemy in the room.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.text: Action. Plant yourself. +4 AC until your next turn.

mark.name: Mark
mark.text: Free action. Mark one enemy — your attacks against it have advantage until it dies or you mark another.

fade.name: Fade
fade.text: Action. DC 13 DEX check to vanish. While hidden your next attack deals +2d6. Attacking breaks it.

trapsense.name: Trapsense
trapsense.text: You automatically detect hazards before they trigger. Searches for concealed dangers succeed without a roll.

cinderbolt.name: Cinderbolt
cinderbolt.text: 1 charge. Ranged attack for 2d6 + your casting modifier in fire. On a crit the target burns for 1d6 at the start of each of its next two turns.

emberwall.name: Emberwall
emberwall.text: 2 charges. You and your allies gain +2 AC until your next turn.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.text: 3 charges. 3d6 to every enemy in the room, DEX save for half. It hits your allies too.

kindle.name: Kindle
kindle.text: 1 charge. Action. Heal an ally or yourself for 1d8 + your WIS modifier.

warding_light.name: Warding Light
warding_light.text: 1 charge. One ally gains advantage on their next saving throw.

last_breath.name: Last Breath
last_breath.text: 3 charges. When an ally would die, they drop to 1 HP instead. Never yourself. Once per character lifetime — not per rest. Lifetime.

unflinching.name: Unflinching
unflinching.text: You have seen worse, and closer. Advantage on every CON saving throw.

deadweight.name: Deadweight
deadweight.text: You know exactly how much a body weighs. +2 damage against anything already below half health.

road_discipline.name: Road Discipline
road_discipline.text: Six seasons of being woken badly. +3 initiative.

escort.name: Escort
escort.text: Once per encounter, the first hit that lands on you deals half damage. You have been standing in front of things for years.

read_the_room.name: Read the Room
read_the_room.text: You are named on the paper of half the monographs down here. Enemy traits, resistances and phase mechanics are spelled out to you on sight.

marginalia.name: Marginalia
marginalia.text: Once per run, FORESEE — somebody wrote this part down. Your next attack, check or saving throw is made with advantage.

light_fingers.name: Light Fingers
light_fingers.text: Nothing you search comes up empty, and the purses are always fatter than they looked.

slip.name: Slip
slip.text: Once per encounter your first attempt to FLEE succeeds without a roll. You have been leaving rooms like this your whole life.

slack_water.name: Slack Water
slack_water.text: Twenty years of reading it. Water never hinders you — no flee penalty, and the flood never fouls your swing.

steady_crossing.name: Steady Crossing
steady_crossing.text: You have kept your feet on worse footing than this. Advantage on every STR saving throw.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.text: You have never once been short-changed. All marks you find are increased by half.

call_in.name: Call It In
call_in.text: Action, once per encounter. Name a debt. Your next hit on that target deals an extra 1d6.

dark_adapted.name: Dark-Adapted
dark_adapted.text: Born below the cut. None of this dark is dark to you. +1 AC.

deep_lungs.name: Deep Lungs
deep_lungs.text: Bad air was your whole childhood. The Drowning Song takes half as much of you as it should.

unbound.name: Unbound
unbound.text: Nothing is holding the lid down any more. +2 to your maximum charges.

recant.name: Recant
recant.text: Once per run, RECANT to refill your charges. It costs you something you would rather not name.

hedge_craft.name: Hedge-Craft
hedge_craft.text: You knew which caps were wrong before you could read. Poison does nothing to you at all.

second_sight.name: Second Sight
second_sight.text: Advantage on every Perception check. You have always seen a little more than was strictly there.

learned_to_run.name: Learned to Run
learned_to_run.text: +4 on every attempt to FLEE. It is the one thing you are indisputably good at.

survivors_instinct.name: Survivor's Instinct
survivors_instinct.text: The first attack against you each encounter has disadvantage. You were already moving.

raise_thrall.name: Raise Thrall
raise_thrall.text: 1 Vitae. Raise a body. You bring one down with you, and after that the fight provides. While it stands, everything in the room goes for it instead of you.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.text: 1 Vitae. Ranged attack for 1d8 necrotic, and you heal for half of what it deals. The Warden does this to you later. Now you know how it feels.

second_death.name: Second Death
second_death.text: When your Thrall falls, it comes apart for 2d6 across every enemy in the room. Nothing you raise dies quietly.
